by: 北京市文物研究所 圆明园考古队 (靳枫毅 et al.)
what_found: The whole 含经堂 palace compound was excavated: the foundations of the gate, 含经堂, 淳化轩, 蕴真斋, 三友轩, 静莲斋 and the rest, some twenty underfloor heating flues (地炕) of the centipede type with stokeholes, and the shop row 买卖街 east of the east wall with 28 stoves. Figures here are second-hand through S940 and S941; the brief itself (S143) is not seen.

by: 北京市考古研究院 with 圆明园管理处
what_found: The gate, the foundations of the stele pavilion and the library, the enclosing walls, stone-paved paths, the base of the 玲峰 rock, one large and one small pool and five culverts for supply and drainage round the court; the library proved six bays wide with black glazed tiles. Figures in metres not yet seen.

by: 北京市文物研究所 (张中华) with 圆明园管理处
what_found: Phase 1 cleared three building sites, 芝兰室, 云萝山馆 and 听泉榭; phase 2 opened 延清堂 and the hill paths: column bases, rockwork, 金砖 floors, steps and walks, some of them not on the Qing drawings, and signs that the whole garden burned. Part is kept as an unexcavated reserve.

year: n.d. (survey report revised on mhymy 2023-03-10; tags name a 慎德堂 dig record)
by: survey report as posted by 圆明园事务总管 on mhymy (北京市文物研究所 surveys, by its series)
what_found: Opening only seen: the island scene measures about 220 x 120 m, 25,000 m2, with 8,600 m2 of buildings and 656 rooms and gallery bays in three lines (centre 圆明园殿, 奉三无私, 九洲清晏殿; east 天地一家春; west 慎德堂, 清晖阁 and others). The 96% with plans, 7 figures and the finds is behind a paywall or the 微圆明园 mini-programme. A note on the page says the rebuilt foundations of the Tongzhi repair were wrecked in 1900 by bannermen and bandits, not the Eight-Nation troops (cf. Q28).

by: 北京市文物研究所, ahead of the planned 圆明园微缩景观工程
what_found: Auger survey of about 110,000 m2 of the 130,000 m2 project area, covering 藻园, 十三所 and 山高水长: at 藻园 the buildings ring a boat dock in an L-shaped zone about 105 m N-S by 95 m E-W.

by: 北京市文物研究所 圆明园课题组 (张中华)
what_found: Foundations of the duty rooms 值房, the gate, 紫碧山房 itself, 含余清 and 澄素楼, with a landing stage, a stone bridge, walls, paths, a stream, the hill and drains; also an earlier wall base with its apron, hill retaining walls, a half-round landing and flagstone paths that no text records.

by: 北京市文物研究所 (published as 《圆明园长春园宫门区遗址发掘报告》, 北京文物与考古系列丛书)
what_found: Survey and excavation of the 长春园 gate area and 澹怀堂: the report describes the building remains in detail and classes the finds; the layout found matches the original design and adds features missing from the site plan of the ruin. The gate was rebuilt on its old site and opened in October 2016 (S142). Figures not seen: the report is locked.

by: (not named in S944; the park's restoration works)
what_found: The 2003 dig at 万方安和 found the original stone intake trough of the 响水 'sounding water' cascade on the west shore by the 卍-shaped hall, where a Yangshi Lei drawing writes 响水; the cascade was then repaired and set running again.

by: 圆明园管理处 / 北京市文物研究所 (as implied by the timeline; agency not named there)
what_found: Scene excavated from spring 2003 together with 碧澜桥 and five other bridges; presentation design approved 2007. A blue-and-white porcelain stool from the pond is among the restored finds (E1339).

by: 圆明园遗址公园 (timeline S981); report S156
what_found: 藻园 cleared in 1994 (S981); the report's free part gives an L-shaped group round a boat dock about 105 x 95 m (E2263)

by: 圆明园管理处 / survey report S152
what_found: site 10,500 m2, buildings 1,600 m2; phases: early Yongzheng two-storey tower and timber bridge pavilion; Daoguang closed in the upper floor and added a square pavilion, a service court and an open hall (E1280)

by: 北京市文物研究所 (news via 新京报 / 中新网)
what_found: service house, gate, halls 紫碧山房, 含余清 and 澄素楼, a landing, stone bridge, walls, roads, a channel and the hill; also an earlier wall footing with apron, a hill retaining wall, a semicircular landing, a drain and a stone path not in the documents (E2318)

by: 北京市文物研究所
what_found: Whole compound cleared: forecourt with pailou footings, paving and yurt foundations; gate; 含经堂 main hall, side halls, 霞翥楼, 梵香楼 and galleries; 淳化轩 with rockery, 蕴真斋, 得胜概; east stage 乐奏钧天 with dressing room and viewing hall 神心妙达; shop street; west 涵光室, 三友轩, 静莲斋, 理心楼, 待月楼, 澄波夕照; enclosing walls and service buildings. Sizes are in the book, not seen.

by: 北京市文物研究所 (靳枫毅等)
what_found: Brief report: site over 60,000 m2, building remains over 30,000 m2 in more than 30 units (E0062). The 地天母 bronze from 梵香楼 was found in this campaign (E0061). Partly restored foundations of 澄波夕照, 得胜概 and a rock pavilion shown since (E0063).

by: 北京市文物研究所
what_found: Phase 1 (2012-13) the west part: 芝兰室, 云萝山馆, 听泉榭; phase 2 (from Nov 2016) the rest, with 延清堂 (platform 25.344 x 22.464 m, 27 of 50 column bases), 含碧楼, 挹霞亭, 观丰榭, 引胜轩, rockery, paths and shores; traces of a long fire.

by: 北京市文物研究所
what_found: Gate quarter of Changchun Yuan: about 21,000 m2 opened, 220 m north-south by 90 m east-west, 210 trenches, 24 building remains in a south and a north area (screen wall, 宫门, 牌楼门, 澹怀堂, 众乐亭, boat landing). Report: 《圆明园长春园宫门区遗址发掘报告》 (ISBN 9787030238252 per the search extract).

by: 北京市文物研究所
what_found: Survey west of 仙人承露台: about 2,586 m2, 55-74 by 26-48 m, with two stone stairs on the north and west (E0664, E0665).

by: 北京市文物研究所
what_found: Survey before conservation: island area A about 50 by 26-48 m (1,690 m2), area B 24 by 22 m (445 m2), water all round, stone-edged (E0652, E0653).

by: 北京市文物研究所
what_found: 2007: island north of 鉴碧亭 edged with stone, three rock piles, 43-86 by 12-81 m, 5,872 m2 (E0791). 2009: the lake north of 正觉寺 between the 鉴碧亭 water and 湛清轩, with an old bridge and a channel (E0686, E0687).

by: 北京市文物研究所
what_found: Survey on the north bank of 湛清轩 at the 四宜书屋 site: rubble to 0.6 m, brown soil with brick scraps to 1.1 m, yellow-brown layer to 1.6 m, then natural ground (E0767, E0768).

by: 北京市文物研究所
what_found: Salvage dig for Metro Line 4 in front of the temple gate on the north bank of 万泉河: about 300 m2, a road base, a carriageway and house remains (E0685). A separate excavation report on 天王殿 exists, title only (S315, E0688).
None up to 2015: no archaeological work at 鉴园, remains mostly under water (S592 section 3.1).
